municipal.conversion: LibreDWG0.14 JSON; bounded mesh extraction; upper-face union; >=70% overlap with OSM footprint

facadeReference.description: The measured crypt terrace518.536m and four tower summit elevations calibrate the photographed upper floor, gables, belfries and pinnacle hierarchy. Window/portal widths, recess depths, stair tread subdivisions and intermediate buttress slopes are synthetic exterior approximations, not a new measured survey.

controls.stairEvidence: Two monumental exterior flights documented by Catalonia Sacra; paths fit within the measured front crypt envelope and the municipal orthophoto. Individual tread elevations estimated between landings.

facadeFrames.evidence: Three raised portal gablets and the principal pointed window surround follow the arrangement in the municipal front reference. Widths and intermediate crown profiles are calibrated visual approximations. Recess depths are intentionally simplified to remain legible in an opaque print; window mullions are broad representative divisions, not exact tracery.
